summary.text: Ken Corbet is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 54 who has represented the district since January 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Corbet owns Ravenwood Lodge and founded the Kansas Hunting Sport Association.

paragraphs.text: Ken Corbet was born in Dover, Kansas, and attended Auburn High School, Baker University and Washburn University.
His career experience includes owning Ravenwood Lodge, and he founded the Kansas Hunting Sport Association.
Corbet took office in the Kansas House on January 14, 2013.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, House Federal and State Affairs, Taxation, and Administrative Rules and Regulations committees.
He defeated Melvin Hicks in the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Chris Tanner in the general election.
